question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 I 组：挪威 vs 塞内加尔（90 分钟三路赛果）
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group I: Norway vs Senegal (90-minute three-way result)
one_liner_cn: 挪威凭 Elo 差距与哈兰德的火力小幅占优，但卫冕非洲杯冠军塞内加尔大赛经验明显更足，三路概率相当接近，挪威仅轻微领先。
one_liner_en: Norway hold a slight edge on Elo and Haaland's firepower, but reigning AFCON champions Senegal bring far more tournament experience — a close three-way race with Norway only narrowly ahead.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差 54 分（挪威 1914 第 11 位 vs 塞内加尔 1860 第 21 位），中立场下挪威为统计层面小热门。
key_reasons.en: A 54-point Elo gap (Norway 1914, #11 vs Senegal 1860, #21) makes Norway the statistical slight favourite on neutral ground.

key_reasons.cn: 塞内加尔是 2026 年 1 月非洲杯冠军，Mané 获赛事最佳球员，全队大赛淘汰赛经验充足。
key_reasons.en: Senegal won AFCON in January 2026 with Mané named player of the tournament — a deeply tournament-tested squad.

key_reasons.cn: 挪威 28 年来首进世界杯，哈兰德预选赛 16 球领衔且健康在列，但全队几乎无世界杯经验。
key_reasons.en: Norway return to the World Cup after 28 years; Haaland (16 qualifying goals) is fit and included, but the squad has almost no World Cup experience.

method_note: Market-blind: Elo (eloratings.net 2026-06-11) Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, no host bonus — neutral venue) gives p_stat Norway 42.9% / Draw 25.7% / Senegal 31.4%; bounded evidence adjustment of ~2pp (within the ±8pp cap) toward Senegal for AFCON-champion tournament pedigree vs Norway's lack of World Cup experience; no injury absences reported on either side. No betting/prediction-market data consulted.
